items.quote: I walked in with a photograph and a very vague idea. What I left with was the best-dressed version of myself I have ever been — and I have never felt so much like myself.
items.name: Naa Densua

items.quote: Three fittings, no fuss, no showroom pressure. Adora listened harder than anyone I have worked with. The kente panel sits exactly the way I drew it on a napkin.
items.name: Efua Boateng

items.quote: I have bought a lot of clothes in my life. This is the only time anyone asked what I actually do in a job interview, and then cut the sleeve to suit it.
items.name: Yaa Asantewaa

items.quote: My mother's aso-oke was too precious to wear. Adora copied it stitch for stitch, made two more, and taught me how to care for all of them.
items.name: Akosua Frimpong
